KEY FACTS:
- In FY 2024, NASA applied the provisions of SFFAS 54, Leases.
- NASA recognized $5.4 million of annual lease expense in FY 2024 associated with leases under SFFAS 54 as a lessee.
- Interest/discount rates based on Treasury marketable securities used for lessee arrangements ranged from 4.69% to 4.88%.
- NASA recognized $48.6 million of annual lease revenue in FY 2024 associated with leases under SFFAS 54 as a lessor.
- Interest/discount rates for lessor arrangements ranged from 1.7% to 8.35%.
